en.summary: India surpassed 50 medals at the Asian Games through achievements including Neeru Dhanda's gold in women's trap shooting and the women's 4x400m relay team's victory, reaching 53 total medals and 10th place overall.

en.title: New NCERT book says Indian kings got swords from goddesses to resist invasions

en.title: Asian Games Medal Tally: How two gold medals lifted India back into the top 10
en.summary: India secured two gold medals on Day 10 of the Asian Games, with Neeru Dhanda setting an Asian Games record in women's trap shooting and the women's 4x400m relay team also winning gold.

stories.title: CoinSwitch swings to profitability in FY26 as crypto platform’s revenue climbs 150% to Rs 324 crore

en.title: CoinSwitch swings to profitability in FY26 as crypto platform's revenue climbs 150% to Rs 324 crore
en.summary: CoinSwitch achieved profitability in FY26 with revenue reaching Rs 324.19 crore, representing 150% growth. The cryptocurrency platform improved its Adjusted EBITDA margin to 27% while expanding its user base to over 2 crore users.

en.summary: Vikram Solar shares increased 3% after winning a 400 MW module supply order for decentralised solar projects in Maharashtra, with deliveries scheduled from October 2026 to March 2027.

en.title: Tata Chemicals, Tata Motors PV, other Tata stocks slide up to 4% as Tata Sons rejig clouds listing prospects
